payload.summary: Resolved fail-closed payload validation, reviewer routing, deadline enforcement, manifest provenance, consensus quorum validation, and deterministic non-transitive grouping. Replacement-vendor scheduling and durable trusted adjudication-ledger handling remain unresolved.
completed_work: Added full findings schema plus count/size gating and auth normalization.
Applied configured SDK thinking values with provenance and enforced post-invocation deadlines.
Added local default reviewer archetype resolution and logical-attempt manifest persistence.
Added relational consensus validation, policy-aware disagreement escalation, input limits, and clique grouping.
Added focused regression tests; targeted suite passed (130 tests).
in_progress: Round-level replacement-vendor scheduling with logical-slot transfer.
Trusted adjudication ledger loading and authorization verification.

decisions.title: Reject invalid findings before quorum
decisions.rationale: Complete schema and size validation now gates recovery eligibility.

decisions.title: Treat post-call overruns as timeout
decisions.rationale: A returned success cannot become quorum-eligible after the logical deadline.

next_steps: Finish the two remaining critical remediation areas, then rerun implementation review.
